references.text: The words of Gaal son of Ebed that Zebul heard were spoken in these verses, where Gaal urged the people of Shechem to rise up against Abimelech
Zebul later confronts Gaal directly about his statements and challenges him to act on his words
Zebul finally drives Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem as a result of his anger
The expression 'his anger was kindled' (וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ) is used in a similar way to describe intense anger
The same Hebrew expression for anger (וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ) is used when Potiphar hears the words about Joseph
